# PDR: «A meeting's note lives where its work is» target state

PDR: «A meeting's note lives where its work is» target state — meeting record (note body, date, participants) on the task it was about; decisions and to-dos as child records; rewrite replaces, undo drops; panel Meetings view

Decided by the owner 2026-11-09 (dirtywork #840): a new record kind, not a task per meeting and not a repo document. First user: dirtywork's desktop app writing work meeting notes to the halil-workspace repo; then the 28 past notes once.
